scope: Repository-only manual browser stock-PDF import in the existing image_editor request server. Not tablet current-document integration.

source_mapping.sample_identity: Decoded source image samples must match this request. First paint must be the opaque direct image; only q/Q/cm may precede it.
source_mapping.unsupported: Multiple pages, image masks/custom Decode, inline/extra images, rotation, UserUnit, differing boxes, moved/scaled/reflected source images and unknown paint state fail closed.

detector.method: Transparent full-page RGBA render, alpha independent of color, plus conservative paint bounds for subpixel/unknown visibility. Known hidden/no-view/invisible/zero-opacity annotations, zero-opacity paths/text, and empty appearance streams do not count as outer ink.
detector.uncertainty: Conservative paint bounds can require consent for unsupported or subpixel visibility. No silent clipping.

consent.terminal_delivery: single completion; stale and cancelled asynchronous results cannot deliver
consent.processing: revision AbortSignal passed to renderer; lifetime cancellation aborts source preparation

retention.retrieval: Real filesystem artifact. Server-local path reported by completion UI and tool result. No automatic deletion.

dependencies.pdf_security: Libraries render/parse supplied bytes; no PDF action/JavaScript engine, link navigation, or remote resource fetch is invoked. Offline uv dependency resolution fails explicitly. This is implementation inspection plus missing-cache smoke, not an exploit audit.

build.warnings: Existing dependency use-client directives and large Vite chunks.

live_tool_and_browser.before_consent: No pdf-tool-result.json existed while consent UI was displayed.
live_tool_and_browser.ordinary_png: Actual rectangle remains across Import stock PDF and Back; Undo remains enabled; returned image contains marks.

validation.tool_limit: LSP initialization failed because its workspace could not locate TypeScript even after local TypeScript install. Scoped bunx tsc passed; source consumers were inspected directly.

remaining_blockers: Real tablet pairing and authenticated LAN transport
